what: Organisation routes this site found itself for each wire's reach page (wire/<slug>/reach.html), under the contact rules it already publishes (world-news-day/data/contact-rules.json): organisations, not people; a role address only, taken from the organisation's own contact page, one hop; the page's bytes hashed when fetched; a failure is a result. No personal address is ever recorded here. The desks may add data/contacts.json to their vaults under the same rules, and the page draws both.

routes.for: the Foundation, its board and its staff

addresses.says: Membership, billing, email provisioning, and general Foundation questions

also.label: A support ticket, the Foundation's Jira service desk, from the same page
The Global Board: seven elected members, meetings open to the public, the page lists them and the meetings

routes.note: The board page publishes no address; the route to the board is the Foundation's support address or a public board meeting.

also.label: The project's page on owasp.org and its repository on GitHub, both in the vault's map (data/map.json); an issue on the repository reaches the leaders without a private address

routes.note: Leaders are named on the project pages and in the map; the route is the project, never a personal address.
